reason: I always forget pills at home when I travel, so a counted sachet I can toss in my gym bag actually fits how I live. At $24.99 for the first box I'd try one, and the named lab report makes it a bit easier to trust.
objection: Still two capsules every single day, and I might just not stick with it past a couple of weeks. Made in China makes me want to open that lab report before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report wasn't really there or the batch number didn't match, I'd skip it.
